abstract: In three cases of choriocarcinoma, genetic loci including a variable number of tandem repeat regions were amplified by the polymerase chain reaction method on DNA from three established cell lines and from lymphocytes of patients and their husbands to identify the responsible pregnancy. Case 1, from whom NaUCC-3 was derived, had only one full-term fetal death. Case 2, from whom NaUCC-4 was derived, had one normal delivery followed by one complete molar delivery and one normal delivery. Case 3, from whom NaUCC-2 was derived, had one normal delivery followed by one complete molar delivery. In case 1, NaUCC-3 was found to be of parental origin and derived from the pregnancy with full-term fetal death. In cases 2 and 3, NaUCC-4 and NaUCC-2 were of probable androgenetic origin and were derived from the pregnancy with complete hydatidiform mole. We also conducted the restriction fragment length polymorphism method using case 1 samples, and it confirmed the results based on the polymerase chain reaction method product patterns. All nine cases of hydatidiform mole and three cases of invasive mole were of androgenetic origin. The polymerase chain reaction method thus makes it possible to identify easily the pregnancy responsible for choriocarcinoma using only a few specimens without isotopes.
abstract_ja: 絨毛癌3例から樹立された細胞株3種のDNAと、患者およびその夫のリンパ球を用いて、縦列反復配列を含む遺伝子座をPCR法で増幅し、絨毛癌の原因となった妊娠を特定した。症例1の由来株NaUCC-3は、正期産の死産に由来する親由来のものであった。症例2の由来株NaUCC-4と症例3の由来株NaUCC-2は、完全胞状奇胎の妊娠に由来する雄性発生の可能性が高かった。症例1の検体を用いたRFLP法でもPCR法の結果を確認した。胞状奇胎9例と侵入奇胎3例はすべて雄性発生であった。このPCR法により、放射性同位元素を用いず少量の検体で絨毛癌の原因妊娠を容易に特定できる。
